prompt: A school bus holds at most $40$ students. Write an inequality for the number of students $s$ that can ride. Write it like "s <= 40".
hint: "At most 40" means 40 is the ceiling: 40 is OK, 41 is not.

hints.text: "At most 40" means 40 is the ceiling: 40 is OK, 41 is not.
So $s$ can be less than 40 OR equal to 40. Which symbol says that?

explanation: "At most 40" means the count can be 40 or anything smaller.
The "or equal" bar matters: exactly 40 students is still allowed.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test the boundary
steps: Can 40 students ride? Yes — "at most 40" allows exactly 40.
An inequality that says yes to 40 and no to 41 must be $s \le 40$.
